The erratum resolves the v2 ambiguity. Explicit JSON Boolean true on the current eligible unmapped request is the sole consent signal. Absent or false grant no consent and other types reject without coercion. Preview and blocked or approved mapped literals stay outside intake even with true.

The current-epoch request-key binding pins validated payload, consent presence and value, and admitted epoch. Identical concurrent consented requests share one job. Changed payload or consent at the current epoch conflicts with no new effect. An expired binding returns stale without prior response or job disclosure. Only the transaction that checks the authoritative epoch and guards the scoped key may create the enqueue effect, otherwise the effect is unavailable.
